description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing recipes in a web application's backend. It includes CRUD operations and search functionality, utilizing Spring annotations for request mapping, validation, and documentation with OpenAPI/Swagger.

classes.name: RecipeController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for CRUD operations and searching recipes. Uses annotations to define URL mappings and API documentation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of recipes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific recipe by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new recipe.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing recipe by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a recipe by ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Handles GET requests to search recipes based on title, ingredients, and tags.
